title: Argentinian Vegetable Tart
description: A delicious vegetarian tart with a crumbly crust and a variety of roasted vegetables.
instructions: 2. Roll out the puff pastry on a lightly floured surface to a thickness of about 1/8 inch.
3. Transfer the pastry to a 9-inch tart pan with a removable bottom.
4. In a large bowl, combine the red onion, yellow bell pepper, red bell pepper, and garlic.
5. Drizzle the olive oil over the vegetables and toss to coat.
6. Spread the vegetable mixture evenly over the pastry, leaving a 1-inch border around the edges.
7. Sprinkle the mozzarella cheese over the vegetables.
8. Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
9. Bake the tart for 25-30 minutes, or until the crust is golden brown and the cheese is melted and bubbly.
10. Remove the tart from the oven and sprinkle with cilantro.
